Antwerp bureau: Richemont and Signet are weighing whether to buy into the consortium seeking De Beers.

Antwerpen: Richemont en Signet overwegen in te stappen in het consortium dat De Beers wil overnemen.

Bloomberg and Reuters report the Cartier owner and the US's Kay/Zales chain are in talks to join the bid for Anglo American's 85%. Botswana's own stake is reported near 25%, up from 15%.
